As a part-time order picker at AS Watson, you play an important role in supplying well-known stores like Kruidvat, Trekpleister, and ICI Paris XL. You work at the distribution center in Heteren, where a headset tells you exactly which products to pick and where to place them. You handle both small and larger products, walk a lot, and keep your fitness up at the same time. You can choose your own shifts: morning (06:00–14:00), afternoon (14:00–22:00), or night (22:00–06:00, for 3-shift schedule). Prefer to work weekends only? That's possible too! Apply today and we'll discuss the options with you. 

- You speak Dutch or English
- You are available at least 16 hours per week
- Available at least one Saturday every 4 weeks. 
- You are fit enough to walk a lot
- You live a maximum of 30 km from Heteren

• Picking orders using a scanner and headset
• Checking for correct quantities and items
• Carefully packaging orders
• Selecting the right packaging material and applying the correct labels
• Performing a final check before the order is shipped.

You work part-time in a shift from 07:00 - 16:00. 

Flexibility is important; you are available at least one Saturday every four weeks (it is not guarranteed that you have to work every four weeks on Saturday). 

- Experience as an order picker is an advantage, but certainly not a requirement
- You are a real team player
- You speak Dutch and/or English
- You are physically able to perform active work
- You are flexible and can work part-time, including the occasional Saturday
